Action Item: Confirm site is on HTTPS sitewide
Implementation Details: Check every URL redirects HTTP to HTTPS with a single 301; fix mixed content warnings.

Action Item: Set one canonical domain version (www vs non-www)
Implementation Details: Pick one version and 301 redirect all other variants (http, non-www, trailing slash) to it.

Action Item: Audit robots.txt for accidental blocks
Implementation Details: Verify robots.txt is not disallowing CSS, JS, or important folders needed for rendering/indexing.

Action Item: Submit and validate XML sitemap
Implementation Details: Ensure sitemap only lists indexable, canonical, 200-status URLs and is submitted in GSC.

Action Item: Fix all 404 errors on internally linked pages
Implementation Details: Crawl the site, find broken internal links, and either fix the link or 301 redirect the dead URL.

Action Item: Eliminate redirect chains and loops
Implementation Details: Any redirect chain of 2+ hops should be shortened to a single direct redirect.

Action Item: Check for duplicate content via canonical tags
Implementation Details: Ensure every page has a self-referencing canonical unless intentionally pointing elsewhere.

Action Item: Set up and verify Google Search Console
Implementation Details: Verify domain-level property (DNS) and confirm all subdomains/protocols are covered.

Action Item: Set up Bing Webmaster Tools
Implementation Details: Import sitemap and verify property for additional index coverage and data.

Action Item: Audit crawl budget on large sites
Implementation Details: For 10,000+ URL sites, check crawl stats report and reduce low-value URL crawling (filters, params).

Action Item: Implement hreflang for international/multilingual pages
Implementation Details: Add correct hreflang + x-default tags and validate with no conflicting signals.

Action Item: Fix orphan pages
Implementation Details: Identify pages with no internal links pointing to them and link them from relevant hub pages.

Action Item: Set up custom 404 page
Implementation Details: Create a helpful branded 404 page with navigation and search box to reduce bounce.

Action Item: Check mobile-friendliness site-wide
Implementation Details: Confirm responsive design passes mobile usability checks on all templates.

Action Item: Validate structured data with no errors
Implementation Details: Run all page templates through the Rich Results Test to catch schema errors.
Recommended Tool(s): Google Rich Results Test, Schema Validator

Action Item: Audit and clean up URL parameters
Implementation Details: Configure parameter handling or canonical tags for faceted/filtered URLs to avoid duplication.

Action Item: Implement pagination best practices
Implementation Details: Use self-canonical on paginated pages (rel=next/prev is deprecated) and ensure crawlability.

Action Item: Check for HTTP status code consistency
Implementation Details: Ensure soft 404s return real 404/410 status codes instead of 200.

Action Item: Review and minimize redirect use in main navigation
Implementation Details: Point nav/menu links directly to final destination URLs, not redirected ones.

Action Item: Set up a staging/robots noindex protocol
Implementation Details: Ensure staging and dev environments use noindex + password protection so they never get indexed.

Action Item: Audit indexed vs submitted pages
Implementation Details: Compare GSC 'Pages' report indexed count vs sitemap submitted count and investigate gaps.

Action Item: Fix 'Crawled - currently not indexed' pages
Implementation Details: Diagnose thin content, duplication, or quality issues causing Google to skip indexing.

Action Item: Remove noindex tags from pages that should rank
Implementation Details: Audit for accidental noindex tags left over from development or CMS defaults.

Action Item: Check for JavaScript rendering issues
Implementation Details: Confirm Googlebot can render and see the same content a user sees (client-side rendered content).
Recommended Tool(s): Google Rich Results Test, Mobile-Friendly Test

Action Item: Consolidate thin/duplicate pages
Implementation Details: Merge or 301 redirect near-duplicate pages targeting the same keyword intent.

Action Item: Audit internal linking depth
Implementation Details: Ensure priority pages are reachable within 3 clicks from the homepage.

Action Item: Set up log file analysis
Implementation Details: Analyze server logs to see what Googlebot actually crawls vs. what you want crawled.

Action Item: Review category/tag archive indexing (CMS sites)
Implementation Details: Decide which taxonomy pages add value and noindex the rest to avoid thin content bloat.

Action Item: Check canonical vs indexed URL mismatches
Implementation Details: Use URL Inspection tool to confirm Google is indexing the canonical URL you intended.

Action Item: Audit for index bloat from search/filter URLs
Implementation Details: Block internal site search result pages and filter combinations from indexing.

Action Item: Request indexing for new priority pages
Implementation Details: Manually submit new cornerstone content via URL Inspection for faster indexing.

Action Item: Review last crawl date on key pages
Implementation Details: Check if important pages are being crawled frequently enough relative to update frequency.

Action Item: Set up a change-frequency strategy in sitemap
Implementation Details: Use lastmod dates accurately in XML sitemap to hint freshness to crawlers.

Action Item: Audit international ccTLD/subfolder crawl coverage
Implementation Details: Confirm each locale variant is being crawled and indexed independently.

Action Item: Clean up legacy redirects (500+ rules)
Implementation Details: Audit .htaccess/redirect map for old chains no longer needed and simplify.

Category / Section: C. Site Speed & Core Web Vitals
Action Item: Measure and fix Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)
Implementation Details: Target under 2.5s; optimize hero image, server response time, and remove render-blocking resources.
Recommended Tool(s): PageSpeed Insights, GSC Core Web Vitals

Category / Section: C. Site Speed & Core Web Vitals
Action Item: Measure and fix Interaction to Next Paint (INP)
Implementation Details: Target under 200ms; reduce heavy JavaScript execution and long main-thread tasks.

Category / Section: C. Site Speed & Core Web Vitals
Action Item: Measure and fix Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
Implementation Details: Target under 0.1; set explicit width/height on images and reserve space for ads/embeds.

Category / Section: C. Site Speed & Core Web Vitals
Action Item: Compress and serve next-gen image formats
Implementation Details: Convert images to WebP/AVIF and compress without visible quality loss.

Category / Section: C. Site Speed & Core Web Vitals
Action Item: Implement lazy loading for below-fold images
Implementation Details: Add loading=lazy to offscreen images/iframes to speed up initial page load.

Category / Section: C. Site Speed & Core Web Vitals
Action Item: Minify CSS, JS, and HTML
Implementation Details: Remove whitespace/comments and combine files where possible to cut payload size.

Category / Section: C. Site Speed & Core Web Vitals
Action Item: Enable browser caching and CDN
Implementation Details: Set long cache-control headers for static assets and serve via a CDN for global speed.

Category / Section: C. Site Speed & Core Web Vitals
Action Item: Audit and reduce third-party scripts
Implementation Details: Remove unused tracking pixels/widgets that add load time without clear ROI.

Category / Section: C. Site Speed & Core Web Vitals
Action Item: Implement server-side caching
Implementation Details: Use full-page or object caching to reduce Time to First Byte (TTFB).

Category / Section: C. Site Speed & Core Web Vitals
Action Item: Preload key requests (fonts, hero image)
Implementation Details: Add <link rel=preload> for critical above-the-fold assets to speed rendering.

Category / Section: C. Site Speed & Core Web Vitals
Action Item: Audit web font loading strategy
Implementation Details: Use font-display: swap and limit font weights/files loaded to reduce blocking.

Category / Section: C. Site Speed & Core Web Vitals
Action Item: Test mobile page speed separately from desktop
Implementation Details: Mobile networks/CPUs are slower; test and optimize using mobile-specific throttling.

Category / Section: C. Site Speed & Core Web Vitals
Action Item: Set up performance monitoring dashboard
Implementation Details: Track Core Web Vitals trends over time instead of one-off checks.

Category / Section: C. Site Speed & Core Web Vitals
Action Item: Reduce DOM size on large templates
Implementation Details: Audit pages with 1,500+ DOM elements and simplify nested markup.

Category / Section: C. Site Speed & Core Web Vitals
Action Item: Audit HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 support
Implementation Details: Confirm the server supports modern protocols for faster parallel asset loading.

Action Item: Audit title tags for uniqueness and keyword targeting
Implementation Details: Every page should have a unique, under-60-character title with primary keyword near the front.

Action Item: Audit meta descriptions for CTR optimization
Implementation Details: Write unique, compelling descriptions under 155 characters with a clear value proposition.

Action Item: Fix missing or multiple H1 tags
Implementation Details: Each page should have exactly one H1 that reflects the primary topic/keyword.

Action Item: Audit heading hierarchy (H1-H6 structure)
Implementation Details: Ensure headings follow logical nested order for readability and topical clarity.

Action Item: Add descriptive alt text to all images
Implementation Details: Alt text should describe the image and include target keywords where natural, for accessibility and image SEO.

Action Item: Optimize URL structure for readability
Implementation Details: URLs should be short, lowercase, hyphenated, and include the target keyword.

Action Item: Improve internal linking with keyword-rich anchor text
Implementation Details: Link related pages together using descriptive, varied anchor text (avoid 'click here').

Action Item: Audit content for keyword cannibalization
Implementation Details: Find multiple pages competing for the same query and consolidate or differentiate intent.
Recommended Tool(s): Ahrefs, Google Search Console Query Data

Action Item: Add table of contents / jump links on long content
Implementation Details: Improve UX and increase chance of sitelinks/featured snippets on long-form pages.

Action Item: Optimize for featured snippets on target queries
Implementation Details: Format direct answers, lists, or tables near the top of content matching snippet triggers.
Recommended Tool(s): Ahrefs SERP Features, Manual SERP Review

Action Item: Audit thin content pages (under 300 words)
Implementation Details: Expand, merge, or remove low-value thin pages that provide little search value.

Action Item: Add breadcrumb navigation site-wide
Implementation Details: Improves UX and enables breadcrumb rich results in the SERP.

Action Item: Review and update outdated content ('content decay')
Implementation Details: Refresh statistics, dates, and examples on pages that have dropped in rankings/traffic.

Action Item: Audit open graph and twitter card tags
Implementation Details: Ensure social share previews display correct title, description, and image.

Action Item: Optimize for E-E-A-T signals
Implementation Details: Add author bios, credentials, citations, and last-updated dates to build trust signals.

Action Item: Add Organization schema to homepage
Implementation Details: Define name, logo, URL, sameAs (social profiles), and contact info in JSON-LD.

Action Item: Add WebSite schema with Sitelinks Search Box
Implementation Details: Enable the SearchAction property so Google can show a search box under your listing.

Action Item: Add BreadcrumbList schema to all pages
Implementation Details: Mark up breadcrumb trail so Google can display breadcrumb rich results in the SERP.

Action Item: Add Product schema on product pages
Implementation Details: Include name, image, price, availability, brand, and SKU for rich e-commerce results.

Action Item: Add Review/AggregateRating schema
Implementation Details: Mark up genuine customer reviews to enable star ratings in search results.

Action Item: Add Article/BlogPosting schema on blog content
Implementation Details: Include headline, author, datePublished, dateModified, and image for news/blog eligibility.

Action Item: Add FAQPage schema on FAQ content
Implementation Details: Mark up genuine Q&A content to be eligible for expandable FAQ rich results.

Action Item: Add LocalBusiness schema (physical/local businesses)
Implementation Details: Include NAP (name, address, phone), hours, geo-coordinates, and price range.

Action Item: Add Event schema for events/webinars pages
Implementation Details: Mark up event name, start/end date, location, and offers for Event rich results.

Action Item: Add HowTo schema on tutorial/guide content
Implementation Details: Mark up ordered steps, tools, and time required for how-to rich results.

Action Item: Add VideoObject schema on video content
Implementation Details: Include thumbnail, upload date, and duration so videos can appear in video search results.

Action Item: Add JobPosting schema on careers pages
Implementation Details: Include title, description, hiring org, and location for Google for Jobs eligibility.

Action Item: Add SoftwareApplication schema on app/tool pages
Implementation Details: Include name, category, OS, rating, and price for app-related rich results.

Action Item: Add Person schema for author/team pages
Implementation Details: Link authors to their bio, credentials, and social profiles for E-E-A-T signals.

Action Item: Set up automated schema QA in CI/deploy pipeline
Implementation Details: Add automated validation so schema errors are caught before pages go live.
Recommended Tool(s): Schema Validator API, Google Rich Results Test API

Action Item: Complete keyword research mapped to buyer intent
Implementation Details: Group keywords by informational, navigational, commercial, and transactional intent.

Action Item: Build a content gap analysis vs top 3 competitors
Implementation Details: Identify ranking keywords competitors have that you don't, and prioritize by opportunity.

Action Item: Create a topic cluster / pillar page structure
Implementation Details: Organize content into pillar pages with supporting cluster content linked internally.

Action Item: Optimize existing top-performing pages further
Implementation Details: Identify pages ranking positions 4-10 and improve content depth to push to top 3.

Action Item: Build a content calendar aligned to seasonality/search demand
Implementation Details: Plan publishing around search volume trends and business seasonality.

Action Item: Audit content for search intent match
Implementation Details: Confirm content format (list, guide, comparison) matches what's actually ranking in the SERP.

Action Item: Add internal FAQ sections targeting long-tail queries
Implementation Details: Answer 'People Also Ask' style questions directly within existing content.

Action Item: Repurpose top content into other formats
Implementation Details: Turn top blog posts into video, infographic, or social content for extended reach.

Action Item: Build a glossary/resource hub for niche terms
Implementation Details: Capture long-tail definitional searches and support topical authority.

Action Item: Audit and update internal linking to new content
Implementation Details: Add links from older relevant posts to newly published pages within 48 hours.

Action Item: Audit backlink profile for toxic links
Implementation Details: Review referring domains for spammy/toxic links and disavow where necessary.

Action Item: Build a target link prospect list
Implementation Details: Identify realistic, relevant sites (competitors' backlinks, industry directories, press) to pursue.

Action Item: Reclaim unlinked brand mentions
Implementation Details: Find mentions of your brand online without a link and request one be added.

Action Item: Fix broken backlinks pointing to your site
Implementation Details: Find backlinks pointing to 404 pages and 301 redirect them to a relevant live page.

Action Item: Pursue digital PR / newsworthy content angles
Implementation Details: Create data studies or original research that naturally attract journalist links.

Action Item: Claim and optimize industry directory listings
Implementation Details: Ensure consistent NAP across relevant, reputable industry directories.

Action Item: Build relationships for guest posting opportunities
Implementation Details: Identify relevant sites accepting guest content and pitch value-adding topics.

Action Item: Monitor competitor new backlink acquisitions
Implementation Details: Set up alerts for competitor backlink gains to spot fresh opportunities quickly.

Action Item: Audit social profile links (sameAs signals)
Implementation Details: Ensure all social profiles are linked consistently and match Organization schema.

Action Item: Evaluate co-marketing / partnership link opportunities
Implementation Details: Identify non-competing partners for reciprocal content or resource page mentions.

Action Item: Fully optimize Google Business Profile
Implementation Details: Complete every field: categories, hours, services, photos, and Q&A; keep NAP consistent with site.

Action Item: Build/audit local citations for NAP consistency
Implementation Details: Ensure Name, Address, Phone match exactly across top directories (Yelp, BBB, industry sites).

Action Item: Generate and respond to Google reviews
Implementation Details: Set up a review request process and respond to all reviews (positive and negative) promptly.

Action Item: Create localized landing pages for multi-location businesses
Implementation Details: Build unique, non-templated pages per location with local content and schema.

Action Item: Build local content (community/local news tie-ins)
Implementation Details: Publish content relevant to the local area to reinforce geographic relevance.

Action Item: Install GA4 with correct data stream setup
Implementation Details: Verify data stream configuration, enhanced measurement, and correct time zone/currency.

Action Item: Set up Google Tag Manager as the single tag management system
Implementation Details: Migrate all tracking pixels/scripts into GTM instead of hardcoding into the site.

Action Item: Define and configure key conversion events in GA4
Implementation Details: Mark form submits, purchases, calls, and signups as Key Events (formerly Conversions).

Action Item: Set up e-commerce tracking (if applicable)
Implementation Details: Implement GA4 enhanced e-commerce for product views, add-to-cart, and purchase events.

Action Item: Set up goal funnels for key user journeys
Implementation Details: Visualize drop-off points across the checkout or lead-gen funnel steps.

Action Item: Implement call tracking for phone conversions
Implementation Details: Use dynamic number insertion to attribute phone calls back to the marketing channel.

Action Item: Set up form submission tracking
Implementation Details: Track every lead form as a distinct conversion event with form name/location.

Action Item: Link GA4 to Google Search Console
Implementation Details: Connect properties to see organic query and landing page data in one place.

Action Item: Link GA4 to Google Ads (if running paid)
Implementation Details: Import GA4 conversions into Google Ads for accurate bidding and attribution.

Action Item: Set up UTM tagging convention for campaigns
Implementation Details: Standardize UTM source/medium/campaign naming so channel data stays clean.

Action Item: Build an SEO performance dashboard
Implementation Details: Combine GSC, GA4, and rank tracking data into one reporting view for stakeholders.

Action Item: Set up scroll depth and engagement tracking
Implementation Details: Track scroll depth and time-on-page for content engagement insights beyond pageviews.

Action Item: Audit for duplicate/double tracking tags
Implementation Details: Check that tracking pixels aren't firing twice, inflating conversion numbers.

Action Item: Set up conversion value tracking for lead quality
Implementation Details: Assign estimated dollar values to different lead types for better ROI reporting.

Action Item: Set up automated anomaly alerts
Implementation Details: Configure alerts for sudden traffic or conversion drops to catch issues early.
Recommended Tool(s): GA4 Custom Insights, Looker Studio Alerts
